title: Shakshuka with Almonds
description: A vegan twist on the classic North African dish, featuring shakshuka in a rich and spicy sauce, topped with toasted almonds.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the Eastern Spice Mix and paprika, stir for 1 minute.
Add the shakshuka, stir to combine, and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tahini and lemon juice.
Create 2-3 wells in the shakshuka mixture and crack in the eggs.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes until the eggs are set.
Sprinkle the sliced almonds on top and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes until golden brown.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
